title: A polynomial splitting into distinct linear factors is separable, and so are its divisors (Stacks 09H3)
statement: Let $K\subseteq L$ be fields [def-pc-field-extension], $K[T]$ the polynomial ring [def-weil-polynomial-ring], and $Q\in K[T]$ a monic polynomial such that $Q=\prod_{j=1}^r(T-\beta_j)$ in $L[T]$ for pairwise distinct $\beta_1,\dots,\beta_r\in L$. Then $Q$ is separable over $K$ [def-pc-separable-polynomial] (coprime to its derivative in $K[T]$), and every $R\in K[T]$ dividing $Q$ in $K[T]$ is separable.
